title: How Agencies Can Scale Video Ad Creative
summary: Scale client video ad creative with standardized inputs, purposeful variants, brand and compliance review, API workflows, and clear production economics.
body_markdown:
## Separate generation from quality control


Every output needs product-fidelity, claim, spelling, caption, audio, continuity, ratio, offer, and destination checks. High volume increases the importance of sampling rules and accountable approval.


## Put API and MCP inside the workflow


A useful integration can:


1. Receive an approved brief and assets.
2. Start defined formats and variants.
3. Return status and stable previews.
4. Route work to review.
5. Accept targeted revisions.
6. Deliver approved files and metadata.


The connector is not the value; fewer handoffs and faster approved output are.


## Price the service


Track strategy time, generation and editing, retries, rights, review, account management, and delivery. Price around campaign coverage and learning, not raw render count.


## Build a multi-format client workflow


Scale the system, not random output.
